base: satsuma-core-2.2.37-duzeltilmis archive of 2026-11-18 (no git history, docs and release/ folder in the archive)
source_tests: 2334 passed, 24 skipped, 13 failed + 4 collection errors on an Ubuntu 24.04 container (Python 3.13). Every failure but one needs PyQt5/PyQt6, which the container lacks; the other is satsuma-core-windows, which still imports the retired satsuma.ram.engine (Windows RAM-ClamAV removal not done).
rpm_build_note: rpmbuild is not available where this source was prepared; build on Fedora with: SATSUMA_RPM_BUILD_ROOT=$(mktemp -d) bash packaging/build.sh
publisher_signature: unavailable; package built locally and not signed
behavior_changes: See docs/RELEASE-2.2.38.md: account-file writes judged by what they changed; account guard covers empty/DES hashes, a second UID 0, 65534 and dynamic users; deep engine starts and connects; reader reads before any writer opens the database and restarts at the end of installation; operator device decision and IP unblock no longer crash; rpm-ostree paths (kargs, /etc sysctl overrides, packaged definitions, rpm-ostree as package manager, no USB kernel argument on ostree); script file modes fixed in the spec; maintenance kit (satsuma-admin bakim, satsuma-maintenance.timer, tam-kontrol covers the whole product); 2.2.39: integrity and quarantine walks follow only links root alone could have placed (Fedora Atomic /opt, /home, /root, /usr/local), quarantine accepts the /var roots of Atomic; 2.2.40: ostree first boot clears Satsuma start limits before %posttrans; maintenance kit accepts units whose condition does not hold and reports failed units outside the enabled list; 2.2.41: DHCP, NTP, TeamViewer and AnyDesk go through the Suricata queue (no channel outside it but loopback); RAM-001 judges sandboxed programs (Snap, Flatpak) by the running file; desktop enrollment copies the Atomic group into /etc/group and the launcher shows why it could not open; 2.2.42: on-access scanning watches the real folder behind /home (Fedora Atomic), retired components are not listed, OPNsense without a log is "not configured"; 2.2.43: folder walkers open first and create only missing folders (no EEXIST audit noise)
ostree_field_report: 2.2.39 on Fedora Atomic: integrity verified (536 files), core services running; first boot needed four attempts (start limits), self-health DEGRADED on satsuma-core-dns and a competing suricata.service
